column1: # Implementation coverage ledger for the schema-8 families.
# The pinned implementation jobs used to answer only "does the pinned build
# still exit 0 against whatever this repository publishes?". Schema 8 showed
# what that answer is worth: both pinned managers returned exit 0 against a
# root carrying the whole schema-8 surface while reading none of it, because a
# family's PRESENCE in the conformance root was never evidence that anything
# This table is the specification's own statement of the other half. It names,
# per pinned implementation, the cases that must be OBSERVED PASSING against
# this repository's in-tree suite, and the root artefacts each of them reads:
#     stops publishing an artefact a row declares, so a family cannot be
#     deleted from the suite while the ledger still claims it is consumed;
#   * `tools/implementation_coverage.py go` fails when a `go` row is not
#     observed passing in that runner's real `go test -json` stream. A rename,
#     a deletion, a package dropped from the invocation, a `-run` filter
#     matching nothing or a skip all fail here BY NAME instead of quietly
#   * `tools/implementation_coverage.py pytest` does the same for a `manager`
#     row against that runner's real `--junitxml` stream, and a row covers
#     every parameterization its test function produces.
# The ledger is deliberately owned HERE rather than deferred to each
# implementation's own consumption ledger: an implementation that renames or
# drops a schema-8 consumer must fail this repository's landing gate, not
# `<package>.<TestName>`, relative to the Go module path. A `manager` identity
# is a pytest nodeid relative to that implementation's checkout. `artefacts`
# is a comma separated list of root-relative published paths or family
# directories; a directory is published when the manifest publishes at least

column4: both halves of the schema-8 manifest bump are loaded, and every published case in them is consumed
every published install-marker-v4 case is read back through the marker reader
every published module-roots case drives declaration, containment and the declared/effective replace bijection to its own failure boundary
every top-level section of the published script-worker family is classified, so a section this specification adds cannot be ignored
the closed policy identity and interpreter set the implementation hard-codes are read back from the suite's own bytes
every published opt-in case decides manifest acceptance and the enforced/declared-only classification
every enforced shape the suite declares is refused before any worker surface
the presence ledger is decided against this suite's manifest inside the run that consumes it
every published agent-skill-v8 and csk-skill-v8 case is collected, and neither family is empty
every published schema-8 manifest case decides acceptance through the real skill-spec loader
every published install-marker-v4 case is collected, and the family is not empty
every published install-marker-v4 case is read back through the marker reader and round-trips
every top-level section of the published module-roots family is classified
every published module-roots case drives the go-v1 driver to its own declared failure boundary
every top-level section of the published script-worker family is classified
the closed policy identity and interpreter set the implementation hard-codes are the suite's own
every published opt-in case decides manifest acceptance and the enforced/declared-only classification
every enforced shape the suite declares is refused before any install mutation
